business_overview.one_sentence: HPC Holdings is a Singapore construction contractor focused on general building construction and civil engineering projects.
business_overview.revenue_model: Construction contract revenue recognised over time for projects in Singapore, from public and private sector customers.
business_notes: Revenue rose 66.79% to S$283.169m as major projects entered peak construction period.
The group had eleven ongoing projects at report date and unsatisfied construction performance obligations of S$1.320421bn.
All activities and assets are located in Singapore.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: One-off gain from acquiring Fishbox/Apollo Aquarium below appraised asset fair value

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value gain on marketable securities
non_recurring_items.business_substance: FVTPL listed equity fair value gain
Release of prior onerous construction contract provision

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank cash, mostly Singapore dollar balances in operating group; only S$0.571m disclosed as USD/HKD
Deposits for periods not more than three months, depending on immediate cash requirements
Separate bank deposits balance was nil at FY2025 year end
funds_assets.source: Annual report 2024/2025 consolidated balance sheet and Note 17

operating_assets.business_substance: Construction receivables including S$0.651m retention receivables
Unbilled construction work and withheld retention amounts, including S$40.890m withheld under contract terms
Operating and leased property/equipment, including new fish farming building from acquisition

investment_assets.business_substance: Listed equity shares measured at FVTPL with Level 1 quoted prices

other_assets.business_substance: Deferred tax assets mainly from onerous contract provision and tax losses
Tender/project deposits, prepayments and short-term employee/non-related receivables

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current portion of SGD bank loan maturing 2035
Non-current portion of SGD bank loan secured by mortgage over 7 Kung Chong Road property
Interest-free loan for subsidiary operation, non-current, disclosed as settled in 2027

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier/subcontractor payables and retention payables, including non-current retention
Advance receipts from construction customers for services still to transfer
Onerous contract provision expected to be used within one year

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deposits, accrued expenses, GST payables and other payables

years.source: Annual report 2022/2023 statements and PPE note

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported OCF was positive in FY2023-FY2025, but project working-capital swings are large. FY2025 profit contains a S$27.572m one-off bargain purchase gain; recurring distributable cash profit is therefore estimated conservatively below reported profit.

evidence.value: Annual Report 2024/2025, financial year ended 31 October 2025
evidence.source: HKEXnews PDF 2026021100926, Directors' Report and statements

evidence.value: General building construction and civil engineering in Singapore
evidence.source: Annual report 2024/2025 Directors' Report and Note 4
evidence.note: All activities and assets located in Singapore.
Cash at banks S$48.954m; short-term bank deposits S$30.175m; separate bank deposits nil.
SGD bank loan matures in 2035 and is secured by mortgage over 7 Kung Chong Road property.
Gain on bargain purchase from Fishbox/Apollo Aquarium acquisition.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by each operating subsidiary; only parent company cash and some USD/HKD currency balances are separately visible.
No explicit restricted cash balance was disclosed, but operating cash requirement for active construction projects is not directly quantified.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not explicitly split; capex is therefore taken from purchase/additions disclosures and treated conservatively.
